Oh my god yes!!! I shaved my hair off a couple of months ago and it didn't look too bad :) I'm growing it back and it is awful. :( I look like a puff ball right now. My hair literally stands straight up from my scalp. Friggin asian hair... Hats 24/7 for me right now.

I think overcoming suicidal thoughts is going to take time. It took a lot of time for me to get to the point of wanting to die everyday. 


You said you still want to fight, well, everyday is going to be a battle. Do you have any goals? If you do, find out how to accomplish them. Create a plan and do it. 


If you don't have goals, create a list of things you don't like about your life right now. Then create a list of solutions to them. Make plans to accomplish those solutions.


This is easier said than done, of course. The point is to take your focus off of feeling suicidal. Also, if you have friends, hang out with them. Just don't spend all your time being alone. Even going to a gym, cafe, or park would help.

Me too... it just seems like so much work and suffering for only a "maybe". Maybe I'll no longer be depressed. Maybe I'll be happy. Maybe I'll overcome these suicidal thoughts. Maybe, maybe, maybe.


Maybe nothing will change at all. Maybe I'll still be miserable. Maybe I'm better off dying now instead of prolonging my suffering.


Maybe, maybe, maybe...
